steps.text: A cold breeze sweeps through the bamboo leaves, sending them rattling like a mournful cry of the dead.
An elite squad of thirty trudges through the woods, hauling the enormous Iju corpse with ropes and logs as they struggle through the trees.
Atop the Escorchgot's carcass, the cursed miasma writhes with life, exuding a sweet yet pungent stench like rotting flesh, and dyeing the surrounding bamboo with its dark hue on contact.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Huh, weird. That black aura can influence the environment?

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: What exactly is this curse, Midnight?

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Many have studied it, yet none have reached a solid conclusion.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: All we know is that anyone who stays near it for too long, or eats meat tainted by it, will also be corrupted before meeting their inexplicable end.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Anywhere tainted with it for too long will also be transformed into a strange and unapproachable land.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: In eastern Houei sits a grove. A century ago, an Iju's curse erupted, turning the place into forbidden land. It remains so even today.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: ...I gotta hand it to you guys for surviving here this long.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Nature gives us many trials, but provides many gifts in exchange.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Haha, I like that. Much better than how some people talk like hunting is a savage sport, and how we should respect all life yadda yadda.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: You mean Orchid?

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Hey, you said it, not me.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: And what about you? Are you fond of hunting?

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Me? Uh... I'm not sure.

steps.name: Samurai
steps.text: Shogun! We're surrounded by beasts!

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Just as planned!

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Do not retreat or engage in battle! Keep marching, for our objective is just ahead!

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Go on ahead. You can leave them to me.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Are you sure?

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: I don't know if I like hunting, but I do know I'm a fan of this weapon!

spans.text: I don't know if I like hunting, but I
know I'm a fan of this weapon!

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: So don't get in my way!

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: ...Got it.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Take this!

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Tch, it's tough!

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: You're not getting away—

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Yoshitsune?!

steps.name: Yoshitsune
steps.text: (Impatient growling)

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Alright... I guess we were thinking the same thing, but don't expect to steal my glory!

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Why don't we see who can defeat the most?

steps.name: Yoshitsune
steps.text: (Disapproving growl)

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Hey, I may have gotten a little too into it back at the volcano, but I learned my lesson!
Catapult swiftly morphs back into sword mode, causing the gloompincer grinding down on her charge blade to lunge right into empty air.
A second gloompincer almost sinks its fangs into her, but her shield moves up just in time for a perfect guard—rather than a purely defensive maneuver, she meets the strike head on.
The impact splits the ground below her feet, yet she remains rooted to the spot. She can clearly feel the enemy's strength flowing through her shield, becoming energy.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: My turn!

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Thoughts, Yoshitsune? I think I'm getting pretty good at this.

steps.name: Yoshitsune
steps.text: (Begrudging growl of acknowledgement)

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Hahah, just look at you! Fine, keep your pride.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Well, that's enough chit-chat, let's go catch up to Midnight!

steps.name: Yoshitsune
steps.text: (Excited howl)

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Here! Cut the ropes then retreat into your designated positions! Quickly!
The samurai cut the ropes, lower the corpse, then quickly dash over to an empty plateau at the edge of the clearing.
The beasts stare at the enormous corpse exuding an irresistible smell, all reason missing from their eyes.
They swarm it in a dense mass, biting and trampling on each other as they vie for their prize.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Whoa... if that many rushed into the city...

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: I trust you won't disappoint me, Suponosuke.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: You fired the signal flare?

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Mhm.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Uh... did we fail? Why isn't anything happening?

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Impossible. The plan was flawless...

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: We did it... the detonation was successful.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: The... The ground's opening up around the corpse! It's all collapsing!

steps.name: Samurai
steps.text: They fell! All the beasts have fallen!

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Hahaha! That was awesome!

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: It's too early to celebrate. We must assess our casualties, then—

steps.name: Samurai B
steps.text: Shogun! The ground below us is opening up as well!

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: No way, this far?!

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: This is bad! The range of the collapse has exceeded our calculations! Scatter, now!
At that moment, a giant boulder rolls down, separating the group.
Amidst the chaos, Catapult and Yoshitsune are split from Midnight, who was protecting the soldiers who almost fell into the abyss, before another falling rock cuts him off from the main forces.

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: Thou needst not keep watch over me. I made a promise to Midnight, and I shall not break my word.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: I believe you.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: I'm just... a little worried.

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: Thy worry is unnecessary. This trial is mine own, after all.

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: The Gyorin sent thee to us, and Houei owes thee.

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: Yet we have hunted the Iju, and the Gyorin has failed us, unable to send thee home. It is my shame.

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: The responsibility is mine to bear.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: You're stretching yourself too thin, Hofukaru.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: The problem with the Gyorin wasn't your fault, or even Houei's. You don't owe us anything.

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: I do appreciate thy kindness, Orchid.

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: But returning home remains thy utmost priority, no?

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: ...It does.

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: Then rest assured, I shall find a way.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: I don't mean to rush you, I just—

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: Is it because of the child I resemble?

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: How did you...?

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: 'Twas apparent from thy treatment of me when first we met. Thou hast also used the name 'Popukar'.

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: Thou must care very much for this child, to extend such concern to me.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: ...It's not just that.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Maybe it was at first, but not anymore.

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: Why, then?

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Because it's only natural to worry about others.

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: Yet it is wasted on me. As I have stated time and time again, I alone am sufficient to resolve the problems that face us.

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: So thou, like Midnight, must believe I am incapable of doing so?

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: ...If it were anyone else, I would've said you were putting on a brave face. But I know you can.

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: Then why—

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: On some level I do understand what Midnight is afraid of.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Not that you might fail, but... that you might succeed.
The loud noise, followed by towering columns of dust flowing from the distant bamboo grove, stuns everyone back in the city.

steps.name: Samurai
steps.text: They did it! The shogun did it! The horde of beasts in the east is... quelled!

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: So he wasn't all talk.

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: Bearing all the danger on his own... as always.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Considering how close you two seem to be, how did such a huge rift form between you?

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: Mother was often occupied with affairs of state... so the shogun stayed by my side. He taught me to fight, and kept me company in my studies. Even after Mother vanished and I ascended the throne, it was he who handled the troublesome matters on my behalf.

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: While I am grateful for his aid, I cannot stand the look in his eyes whenever the Lord of Thunder is mentioned.

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: He hath never truly restrained my actions, yet his eyes seemed to say: 'Try, then, and when you fail you will know why.'

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: ...I'm not saying he doesn't have his issues, but how about we all get together for a meal when he gets back?

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: You two really need to talk this out. What do you think?

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: ...As you wish.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Midnight?! Where'd he go?!

steps.name: Samurai
steps.text: The shogun came to our rescue, and... and the rockslide carried him away!
She suddenly hears a familiar regal roar echoing in the distance, freezing her in place. The sound pierces through the dust and rumbling, striking at her very soul.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: That sound... Was that the Lord of Thunder?! Why's it here?! Why now?!

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Yoshitsune, let's go!

steps.name: Yoshitsune
steps.text: (Anxious growl)

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: (Are those... the samurai under Midnight's command? They've all fallen... but what's with the beast corpses around them? What happened here?)

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: (Midnight?!)

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: (How is he so heavily wounded? Armor's cracked... blade's broken... hey, you gotta be kidding me. Don't die on me now!)

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Just hold on!

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: (Gah! I can't move! What's with this pressure from nowhere...?! I'm scared—my body's no longer listening to me...)

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: (My head... can barely look up...)

steps.name: Yoshitsune
steps.text: (Angry howl)

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: (Is that... the Lord of Thunder?!)

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: (Something seems... off...)

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: (That dark aura... gotta be the curse, right? Probably got it from those beast corpses...)

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: (Wait, it's glowing? What is that? That white light...)

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: (I've seen that before! From when Hofukaru dances! How's that possible?!)

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: (It's... absorbing the miasma! Is it using Hofukaru's power?!)

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: (But how?! How can a beast use a sacred power passed down through her lineage?! Unless...)
The Lord of Thunder seems satisfied after absorbing all the curse in the area.
It looks down, casting a cold, fleeting glance at Midnight sprawled on the ground before throwing its head back for a deafening howl toward the sky.
The roar seems to be filled with boundless majesty... and a declaration of victory.
